subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw approve this batch of 14 new third-party action revisions for workflows that handle tokens, secrets, security results, agent execution, and image publishing?
rationale: The patch has no concrete correctness defect, but CI alone cannot authorize new executable supply-chain revisions in privileged workflows or establish the repository's acceptable review depth for the combined batch.

options.title: Approve after exact-head validation
options.body: Review the upstream release deltas, require the relevant privileged workflow checks to complete successfully on this head, then merge the batch.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate token, Codex, CodeQL, and Docker publishing actions into smaller PRs if maintainers want narrower audit and rollback boundaries.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Leave the current pins in place until an owner is available to review the privileged upstream revisions.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head validation
recommendation.body: Review the upstream release deltas, require the relevant privileged workflow checks to complete successfully on this head, then merge the batch.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person directly to Docker release workflow hardening and exact-path validation affected by the dependency batch.
